contributions.anchor: Form A 'Total Contributions: (to line 1 of report): $13,100 -'
contributions.detail: the 4 Form A rows (5,000 + 2,500 + 600 + 5,000) sum to 13,100 = the schedule's own printed total = the cover's Totals for THIS REPORT cell on line 1; the cover's CUMULATIVE 68,710.05 = 55,610.05 carried from prior reports + 13,100, and those prior periods are not itemized here (officeholder account). NOTE HOW ROW 1 WAS SETTLED: its leading figure is bistable between 5,000 and 5,400 even at 1400 dpi (the filer's slashed zeros and his 4 are similar loops). Three independently printed figures fix it at 5,000 - the schedule's own total 13,100, the cover's This Report 13,100, and the cover's cumulative 68,710.05 minus 55,610.05 - so 13,100 - 2,500 - 600 - 5,000 = 5,000. Arithmetic closure outranks the glyph read (GOTCHAS, the Rhodes reversal); no figure was nudged.

Row 4 (UT GOP) reads as '3,177.5' at 200 dpi full page and as '$3,777 -' on an 1800 dpi tight crop; the arithmetic is decisive for 3,777.00 (8,477.55 - 1,499.33 - 500 - 165 - 2,536.22 = 3,777.00). Cumulative 47,170.01 is not itemized here.

itemized.notes: HANDWRITTEN 2024 3-line form, three pages: p91 cover ('October 29' box ticked, signed 28 Oct. 2024), p92 FORM A, p93 FORM B. Unlike this filer's April filing in the same archive, the county did NOT redact the cover here - the street address and cell phone are printed in the clear (retained as published, per PRIVACY.md; nothing from the cover is carried into these rows). OFFICEHOLDER ACCOUNT: the cover opens from 55,610.05 / 38,692.46 carried forward, so both schedules itemize the PERIOD only and both sides are period-exact. FILER ARITHMETIC ON THE COVER, RETAINED: 68,710.05 - 47,170.01 = 21,540.04 but the printed cumulative ending balance is 21,840.01 (a 299.97 filer discrepancy already recorded in the stated-totals cache); it is NOT a schedule problem - each schedule closes exactly to its own printed total. NO YEAR APPEARS ON ANY TRANSACTION DATE on either schedule (the filer wrote 10/11, 10/15, 10/22, 10/16, 10/23, 10/25 and one ditto mark); every date is kept verbatim and no year was inferred from the report date. THE FILER WROTE NO STREET ADDRESSES ON FORM A - the Address column holds city and state only - so the blank street is the filer's own omission, not a privacy trim. Neither schedule prints a per-page subtotal.
